name: Lambda Credential Theft via SSRF
description: A Lambda function vulnerable to SSRF can be triggered with input that causes it to make HTTP requests to the Instance Metadata Service (169.254.169.254). Lambda runs on EC2-like infrastructure and has IMDS access. The function fetches its execution role credentials and may return them in the response or log them. The attacker triggers the Lambda (e.g., via a webhook or API) with malicious input. No AWS permissions are required if the Lambda is publicly invokable; otherwise the attacker needs lambda:InvokeFunction.
